issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Minneapolis Man Sentenced to 43 Months for Role in Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
supports: Abdullahe Nur Jesow was sentenced to 43 months in prison and two years of supervised release.
Jesow was ordered to pay $866,458 in restitution.
does_not_support: The restitution order is not proof that $866,458 has been collected.
